query: This repo calls https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 with OPENROUTER_API_KEY in four places. Migrate it all to Phaseo.
expected_behavior: Inventories every OpenRouter usage before editing
Replaces the endpoint and key with the Phaseo base URL and PHASEO_API_KEY
Checks model IDs against data[].id from GET /v1/models?format=openai instead of assuming they match, and maps known org differences such as meta-llama/ to meta/
Validates with health, models, a non-streaming and a streaming request, and produces a migration report

query: Our OpenRouter requests send a provider object with order and allow_fallbacks. What happens to that on Phaseo?
expected_behavior: States that provider.order and provider.allow_fallbacks work unchanged on Phaseo
Does not tell the user to remove or rewrite the provider object
Mentions that data_collection: "deny" is rejected and zdr: true replaces it, if the object uses it

query: Our OpenRouter calls use models like x-ai/grok-4:online, send usage: { include: true }, transforms: ["middle-out"] and a file-parser plugin. Move them to Phaseo.
expected_behavior: Removes usage: { include: true }, transforms and the file-parser plugin because Phaseo rejects them, and says usage and cost are always returned
Maps the x-ai/ org to spacex-ai/ and replaces the :online suffix with web search, then verifies the ID with GET /v1/models?format=openai
Lists the behaviour that is lost (middle-out compression, file parsing) as parity gaps

query: I found sk-or-v1 keys in .env.example and a test fixture. We're switching to Phaseo.
expected_behavior: Warns that real keys must be rotated if they were ever committed

query: We use LiteLLM proxy with a config.yaml of model aliases. How do we move to Phaseo?
expected_behavior: Uses the general migration skill rather than the OpenRouter playbook
